gamma.convention: Dealer GEX approximation: call GEX = +gamma*OI*100*S^2*0.01, put GEX = -gamma*OI*100*S^2*0.01 ($ of delta hedging per 1% move; assumes dealers long calls / short puts, the common public convention). Positive total = dealers dampen moves (pinning); negative = dealers amplify moves.
gamma.disclaimer: Free public data; estimate only; supporting signal for PAPER trading; never places orders.
